title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
lineage: FOB - Senn 421's> Sony TC-D5 (at mouth of the stage)> Nak Dragon Playback> HHB CDR-850 (no DAT gen)> CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a rain‑soaked Red Rocks gig that delivers a smoking Shakedown Street, world‑ending Let It Grow and an iconic St. Stephen tease.
ai_review.review: The show captures the Dead at one of their most electric July ’82 Red Rocks performances – a thunder‑filled first set highlighted by Shakedown Street and a blistering Let It Grow, followed by a tight Not Fade Away and a legendary St. Stephen tease that had the crowd in hysteria.  The audience (FOB) tape, mastered by Jim Wise, is praised for its vivid ambience and clarity despite occasional level‑touch complaints, making it a highly listenable document of this historic night.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 4–5 star reviews praise both the musical performance (energy, standout songs) and the recording quality; weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, lively FOB mix with vivid crowd ambience; occasional level‑touch comments but overall clear and well‑balanced, no major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy first set despite rain, flowing into a tight second set with seamless transitions and memorable teases; the weather added drama without hindering performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for scorching tone, intense solos on Let It Grow and Shakedown Street, and a humor‑filled second solo that made listeners laugh.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as smiling and ready to go; occasional “Phil bombs” vibe noted but no detailed critique.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for alternate lyrics in Truckin', occasional lyric flubs, and strong vocal delivery on Not Fade Away.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s piano described as jangly and a highlight of the sound; keyboard work praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum jams after the first set highlighted as excellent; no specific criticism.
